title: Educational broth-microdilution endpoint

sourceReferences.title: EUCAST reading guide for broth microdilution
supports: Broth microdilution validity requires a satisfactory positive growth control.
The standard endpoint is the lowest tested concentration that completely inhibits visible growth, with method-specific exceptions.

readouts.label: Reviewed binary growth observation
readouts.interpretation: Profile-coded 1 means growth and 0 means no growth after explicit review.

validityRange: Only the explicitly authored concentration component and reviewed binary-growth readout are interpreted.
The supplying protocol must define organism/sample, medium, inoculum, incubation, concentration series, and endpoint reading conditions.

materialDefaults.label: Protocol-defined broth, compound, and sample inputs
materialDefaults.note: No organism, drug, medium, inoculum, or amount is selected automatically.

materialDefaults.label: Broth-microdilution plate and consumables
materialDefaults.note: Planning requires explicit quantities and dead-volume policy.

limitations: This profile does not claim ISO, CLSI, or EUCAST conformity; the citation supports the bounded endpoint concept only.
No clinical breakpoint, susceptibility category, species/drug selection, treatment advice, or safety certification is included.
Invalid controls, conflicting replicates, missing concentrations, or non-monotonic outcomes make the endpoint indeterminate.
Image-derived observations require explicit review and remain labeled by source.
